needed.evidence: No footway on the right; the person on foot is walking in the carriageway beside the rickshaw.
needed.suggestion: Provide a continuous footway on the right side so pedestrians are not forced to walk in the carriageway.

needed.evidence: The left footway is occupied by a loaded cart and piled goods, blocking passage.
needed.suggestion: Clear the cart and goods from the left footway to restore a usable pedestrian route.

needed.evidence: The left footway is uneven and littered with debris and piled material.
needed.suggestion: Resurface and level the left footway to remove the uneven, debris-covered trip hazards.

needed.evidence: People are in the carriageway and there is commercial activity on both sides, but no crossing facility is visible.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at this high-demand point to give people a safe place to cross.
